observed_failure: The complete 2022 extraction succeeded, but train.py required all three stage names to be present among nonempty matrices before executing its already-frozen early sample gate. Because the FIT period produced zero rows, the stage name was absent and the runner raised instead of writing FIT_SAMPLE_BELOW_GATE.

change.new_behavior: Reject unknown stage names, but allow a frozen stage with zero rows to remain absent so the existing early sample gate records zero and returns FIT_SAMPLE_BELOW_GATE.
change.expected_result: FIT_SAMPLE_BELOW_GATE with fit_rows=0, no model bundle and all later periods sealed

scientific_contract_unchanged: BTC displacement and SOL/XRP overdelivery definition
outcome_interpretation: Hard-valid event/sample scarcity. The model cannot be estimated because the entire frozen FIT partition contains zero complete rows; no directional or economic inference is made from calibration or confirmation rows.
